notes: Firmware 0.2.0 — the full-audit release: the touch task can no longer steal the display's replies (it parks BEFORE the UART read when the raw-mode owner has the wire); the raw-mode ownership is re-armed at every TFT attempt (the MQTT display writes can never interleave into a block stream); the post-delivery navigation actually runs (raw mode cleared before it — the old one was dead-on-arrival); the task watchdog resumes on every OTA exit path (the crash protection no longer silently dies after the first routine check); the relay state follows the requested index under reverse_relays; the relay boot defaults (the studio's 'always on') applied at boot; the dash map ids to 255 + a real seqlock; the idle timeout honors 0=disabled; one heap semantic; the RSSI refreshed on read; the OTA state/progress ride the status report; the config save serialized; a dozen dead-code removals. Carries all prior fixes.

bug_fixes: 0.1.7/0.1.8: the boot reset reason is visible on the panel's web UI after every boot; TFT updates are refused while the display is not responding.
